notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for the official IEEE 1516.1 regional attribute-value response delivery surface. The source uses only the standard C++ RTIambassador/FederateAmbassador APIs plus the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, dimensional FOM, endpoint, callback configuration, and any logical-time implementation. It verifies Request Attribute Value Update callbacks, current-overlap re-evaluation before reflection, region-designator metadata, and restored ordinary value, tag, transportation, and producer metadata without provider-specific names, registries, headers, or implementation behavior.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador regional subscription, registration, Request Attribute Value Update, region modification, and Update Attribute Values services with FederateAmbassador discovery, provide, and reflect callbacks
